title: Scenario A: Neighborhood Small Business Owner

persona.name: Marcus Vance
persona.location: Atlanta, GA (30310 — West End / Historic Southwest Atlanta)
persona.need_summary: Looking for non-dilutive grant funding or low-interest loan to upgrade espresso machinery and expand commercial kitchen space, plus guidance on corporate catering contracts.

user_prompt: I run a small neighborhood café in West End Atlanta and need help finding business coaching and funding opportunities to expand our kitchen equipment.
explanation_notes: Matched Invest Atlanta Opportunity Fund due to commercial location inside City of Atlanta limits and 2-year operational history.
Matched Russell Innovation Center (RICE) for capital-readiness coaching tailored to Black entrepreneurs.
Flagged Invest Atlanta municipal tax compliance as an item Marcus must confirm before applying.

demo_action_plan.title: Vance Roasters Expansion & Capital Plan
demo_action_plan.goal: Prepare financial documentation, apply for Invest Atlanta Opportunity loan, and enroll in RICE capital cohort.

tasks.title: Confirm City of Atlanta Municipal Business License & Tax Status
tasks.description: Verify current commercial license is up-to-date with City of Atlanta Department of Finance.
tasks.notes: Checked city portal on Oct 10 — license is active with zero outstanding municipal fees.

tasks.title: Compile Last 2 Years Business Tax Returns & 3 Months Bank Statements
tasks.description: Gather financial statements required for Invest Atlanta & ACE loan applications.
tasks.notes: Bookkeeper generated P&L; downloading September bank statement PDF.

tasks.title: Book Free 1-on-1 Mentor Consultation with SCORE Atlanta
tasks.description: Review loan application deck and espresso equipment quotes with an SBA volunteer advisor.

tasks.title: Submit Intake Application for RICE Business Growth Academy
tasks.description: Apply for the quarterly cohort to access mentoring, investor pitch prep, and peer founder network.

title: Scenario B: Resident Seeking Utility & Essential Support

persona.name: Keisha Jenkins
persona.need_summary: Experiencing sudden seasonal heating bill spikes and looking for emergency energy assistance and family grocery resources while completing job training.

user_prompt: I need help with utility bills and grocery assistance while I look for a new job in Atlanta.
explanation_notes: Matched LIHEAP Energy Assistance because Keisha is responsible for heating costs in Georgia.
Identified that household gross income must be confirmed at or below 60% Georgia median income.
Paired with Atlanta Community Food Bank for zero-cost immediate emergency food access without income paperwork.
Added Urban League of Greater Atlanta Career Center for tuition-free certification programs.

demo_action_plan.title: Keisha's Immediate Relief & Career Stability Plan
demo_action_plan.goal: Secure utility bill grant via LIHEAP, access neighborhood fresh food, and enroll in certified job training.

tasks.title: Gather Heating & Electric Bills + Proof of 30-Day Income for LIHEAP
tasks.description: Collect utility statements with account numbers and proof of income for all household members.
tasks.notes: Georgia Power bill downloaded; need one more paystub.

tasks.title: Text 'FINDFOOD' to 888-976-2232 for Nearest Friday Pantry Distribution
tasks.description: Locate walking-distance Atlanta Community Food Bank emergency grocery pantry in 30314.
tasks.notes: Text received: distribution scheduled this Friday at 10:00 AM at local neighborhood center.

tasks.title: Submit Online Application on Georgia Gateway for LIHEAP Grant
tasks.description: Submit application before seasonal funds are exhausted for direct account credit.

tasks.title: Attend Urban League or Goodwill Career Training Orientation
tasks.description: Explore tuition-free healthcare or IT certification tracks with career placement.
